metadata.title: Cinematic Portrait with Minimalist Sans-Serif Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast male portrait featuring a three-quarter profile against a soft, painterly bokeh background of teal and sunset hues. The lighting is directional, creating deep shadows on the right side of the face while highlighting skin texture and facial features. Minimalist, lowercase white typography is positioned at the bottom corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones against a cool teal and muted orange background
Sharp focus on the subject's eyes and facial texture versus a soft-focus background
Extreme contrast between the dark clothing/shadows and the bright white typography
Asymmetrical typographic balance anchored to the bottom edge
coreInvariants: Directional lighting from the upper left
Short, textured hairstyle with visible stubble
Muted, desaturated color palette for the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the central and right two-thirds of the frame, cropped from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's left eye (viewer's left) acts as the primary focal point due to sharpness and lighting.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the subject's gaze, moves down the bridge of the nose to the mouth, then drops to the white text at the bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant provides breathing room with a blurred, atmospheric horizon line.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the subject's hair and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Teal and soft cyan in the background sky.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm peach and orange highlights on the skin and horizon.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between skin highlights and deep shadows; low saturation in the background to maintain focus on the subject.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and muted teals

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase only for all text elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'l' is a simple vertical bar
The 'p' has a descender that does not curve

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlaid on dark areas for maximum legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both name and title to maintain minimalist aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and monolinear weight.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and lowercase charm.
Modern, clean, and highly legible at small scales.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail portrait of a man with short textured hair in a dark shirt, lit from the side. The background should be a heavily blurred, out-of-focus seascape at dusk with teal and orange tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase geometric sans-serif text in solid white. Place the name in the bottom-left corner and the short title in the bottom-right corner, ensuring they are aligned with the margins.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting directional and high-contrast?
Is the background sufficiently blurred to create depth?
Is the font a clean, geometric sans-serif?

postGenerationChecks: Check for monolinear stroke weight in text
Ensure the subject's gaze is directed toward the camera
Verify the white text is perfectly legible against the dark foreground
Confirm the color palette remains within the teal/orange/black spectrum
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait subject + Directional Key Light + Bokeh Seascape Background + Lower-Corner Geometric Sans Typography
